what: A single SVG line like a handwritten signature is drawn from start to end, tied to scroll, from when the panel head reaches the screen center until it reaches the screen top (stroke-dashoffset, no easing curve). Scrolling back up erases it. Below 767px a separate phone line can be drawn

options.scrub: Lag when following scroll (s) — default true (immediate). brand wave 3

note: Stroke color is currentColor — it takes the text color of wherever it is used. Stroke width goes on the path

from.where: shared.js footer .rc-sign — original initDrawPathOnScroll: linear, clamp(top center) → clamp(top top), scrub, mobile SVG below 767px (Draw Path on Scroll)
shared.js [data-ribbon-draw=dash] Second section blue wave (original #wavePath: stroke-dashoffset length→0, start top 80% · end bottom bottom · scrub 3)
from.options: start: top 80%; end: bottom bottom; scrub: 3

from.where: shared.css .mg-orn thick teal curve (original .ornament — start top center+=10 · end bottom center+=10, near the document end it pulls to the end → clamp)
